_what: Meeting links as one declared router (read-data/meeting-links.mjs). A row of `routes` says which URL schemes and host patterns it reads, which action words it knows (the first path part, or the `action` query parameter when `action_from` is query) and which parameters each action may carry. The host is checked against the row's `hosts` before any parameter is read; a parameter the row does not name is dropped, and one marked `secret` is returned for the caller to use but is shown as `secret_params` so a log never prints it. A new meeting app is one more row. `roster` says how attendee updates arrive: a `full` update replaces the roster, an `incremental` one adds, changes and removes by attendee id.

words.no_route: No meeting app here reads a {scheme} link.
words.host_refused: The host {host} is not one this meeting app reads.
words.no_action: The link names no action this meeting app knows ({action}).
words.bad_param: The {name} in the link is not in the form this meeting app uses.
